hooks.command: bash -c 'CMD=$(jq -r ".tool_input.command // \"\"" 2>/dev/null); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "git push.*\b(main|master)\b"; then echo "BLOCKED: git push to main/master is not allowed without explicit override" >&2; exit 2; fi; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "rm -rf /( |$)|rm -rf /\*"; then echo "BLOCKED: rm -rf on root" >&2; exit 2; fi; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qiE "DROP\s+TABLE\b"; then echo "BLOCKED: DROP TABLE detected — confirm explicitly via raw psql" >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0'

bash -c 'set -e; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; if ! command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; if ! git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; LAST_COMMIT_TS=$(git log -1 --format=%ct 2>/dev/null || echo 0); NOW=$(date +%s); DIFF=$((NOW - LAST_COMMIT_TS)); if [ "$DIFF" -gt 300 ]; then exit 0; fi; CHANGED=$(git show --name-only --pretty=format: HEAD 2>/dev/null || true); HIT=0; if echo "$CHANGED" | grep -qE "^backend/src/|^frontend/src/|\.prisma$"; then HIT=1; fi; if [ "$HIT" = "1" ]; then SB=$(echo "$CHANGED" | grep -E "^second-brain/" || true); if [ -z "$SB" ]; then echo "WARNING: коммит затронул код (backend/src, frontend/src, *.prisma), но second-brain/ не обновлён в этом коммите. Проверь по таблице в CLAUDE.md (триггер 1)." >&2; fi; fi; exit 0'
